author: Midland Times
title: Midland ISD reviews progress on new campuses, major renovations in bond-funded projects
text:
During its Tuesday meeting, the Midland Independent School District (ISD) Board of Trustees received a detailed update on the progress of several major construction and renovation projects across the district. These projects include new school campuses and campus improvements funded by recent bond measures.
According to the board, construction on Lone Star Trails Elementary, part of Package 01, is nearing completion at 97 percent, with full delivery scheduled by August 13. The terrazzo flooring is complete, furniture delivery is underway, and landscaping began mid-July. Playground and shade sail installation is in progress, along with the final touches to parking areas and technology systems.
Significant updates were also provided for the district’s two new high school campuses under Package 02, which are expected to be completed by August 2028. Construction documents are nearly finalized, and contractors have mobilized. Work has also begun on key infrastructure roads, and a pilot installation of classroom furniture is scheduled for early August.
Several renovation packages are currently in progress across elementary and middle schools. Package 03, covering six elementary campuses, is ahead of schedule and under budget, with fire sprinkler and lighting installations expected to wrap up by August 4. Similarly, middle school renovations under Packages 04 and 05 have completed preparatory steps, including asbestos abatement and the relocation of portable classrooms, with construction work set to begin soon.
